messages:
anya: FYI I'm starting the onboarding run for spectral-48k-int3 on staging. Running the long-context harness + our int3 quant pipeline. Seeing a reproducible KV replay divergence after ~34k tokens.

anya: Repro steps I used: ran full longctx bench with warmstart enabled, same prompt, compare outputs vs float32 baseline. mismatch shows at token index ~34123 and grows.

anya: Quick paste from the short log:```
[2026-03-22T14:07:12Z] model=spectral-48k-int3 quant=int3 kvcache_hits=0.87 kvcache_mismatch=0.0727 rope_scale=0.9997 seq_len=46000
[2026-03-22T14:07:12Z] first_mismatch_token=34123 token_diff_sample="the quick brown"
```

david: ugh. mismatch ~7% is high. did you also try disabling warmstart? that rules out prefill vs inflight differences.

anya: yes, tried warmstart=false. mismatch still appears but delayed ~200 tokens (now ~34320). suggests it's related to cumulative rotary indexing, not just prefill handshake.

sheng: can you dump the per-layer rotary_scale and kv index for the failing step? might be a scale quantization rounding accumulating.

anya: attached small dump in gist (internal): https://redwood.internal/gists/gn7k/spectral-int3-dump — includes layer-wise rotary_scale before/after quant apply. summary: top layers show small drift (~1e-3) compared to float baseline.

maria: Is this unique to spectral variant or also on the 32k baselines?

anya: 32k float and int3 baseline didn't show the divergence in the same prompt. This model's positional interpolation path + larger context seems to amplify rounding.

sam: Hypothesis: the quantized kernel for rotary uses fused scaled-index with int accumulator; small off-by-one in the mod index when seq_len > 32768. We had a similar bug but for tiled sharding earlier.

sheng: good call. check the kernel that computes rot_idx = (pos * rot_step) % rot_mod. If rot_mod is stored as float16 somewhere during quant path, rounding can drift.

anya: I dumped a micro-benchmark:```
$ ./bin/rot_idx_check --model spectral-48k-int3 --start 33000 --end 34500
rot_idx_delta_mean=0.00095
rot_idx_max_delta=0.0021
```

anya: I also ran a quick float32 vs int3 comparison with identical seeds:```
> cmp_out --baseline float32 --cand int3 --prompt prime_long.txt --len 46000
divergence_token=34123 divergence_reason="kv_token_mismatch"
```

david: ok let's triage plan: 1) infra can run a kernel-only test to confirm rot_idx math under quant path, 2) run a canary with prefix_cache disabled to see if cache recomputation avoids accumulation, 3) if confirmed, revert the fused rot-index optimization for int kernels for now.

infra-bot: Scheduled job #7812: kernel-rot-check on gpu-staging-12 (queued). ETA ~15m.

maria: I'll snapshot telemetry for the failing run and compare kvcache_hit patterns and per-shard rot_idx histograms.

sam: Also compare model compile flags: maybe an extra -ffast-math slipped into int3 build for that shard. small fp reorderings can matter over long sequences.

anya: For visibility, putting current benchmark numbers (staging, p95 latency): float32 baseline p95=210ms p50=120ms; int3 quant p95=195ms p50=110ms. So performance is fine but correctness is the blocker.

anya: Next steps I can do today: produce a minimal repro that isolates rot_idx delta to a single layer and open a PR to disable the fused path. If someone can watch the kernel job and grab the nvprof trace that'd be great.

david: I'll watch the job and grab traces. If repro is small we can hotfix the quant kernel and run a short canary tomorrow 09:30 PT. @maria please prepare the canary checklist (metrics, rollback triggers, eval prompts).

maria: Will do. adding the eval set with long-turn prompts and golden responses. will include both token-level diff and semantic eval (BLEU-ish + embed similarity).

sheng: If we end up reverting, we should also add a unit test that runs rot_idx sequences at 4 different breakpoints: 31k, 32k, 34k, 46k to catch regressions.

anya: agreed. I'll draft the unit test and link it in the PR. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: job #7812 completed: rot-check OK for integer overflow, rot_idx_deltas attached to job log: https://redwood.internal/jobs/7812/logs

david: log looks clean but need full nvprof to see fused path ops. grabbing now.

anya: I'll open the PR with test + option to toggle fused_rot_idx in compile flags. PR link when ready.

maria: tagging QA for canary review once PR lands.

sam: nice triage, short-lived canary seems safest. keep perf guardrails in place.

anya: filing the thread summary in the onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/onboard/spectral-48k-int3 — will add repro steps and telemetry pointers.
